notes.title: Small Fix - QoL and Dispensers
notes.content:
Hello Builders!

Some of you reported a couple of issues, so here's the fix:
- Stackers and Gluers: When the machine rejects an input many times, it will clear all its content so belts won't get stuck. 
- Dispensers: Now, loading a save will set the correct u/m for them, as this was failing in some cases.

We've made also some QoL changes for new players.

If you come across other bugs or more feedback, please use the Feedback Page to let us know!

notes.title: Second batch of fixes and improvements!
notes.content:
Hello Builders!  


We are working hard on improving the game, so we are bringing another patch with more bug fixing and polish, as well as a some performance improvement while we keep working on it as our top priority.  More on that below!  



Fix: Mistakes on Localization 

Fix: Machines and conveyors with stuck items 

Fix: Loading stuck on some saves 

Fix: Mixer color bug 

Fix: Tiny pieces in creative mode 

Fix: Loading stuck on creative mode figures 

Fix: Teleports should not be stuck when loading 

Fix: Crushers shouldn't show visually stuck blocks 

Fix: Now when you have disabled sounds on settings the game should perform better and be less likely to crash. 

Fix: u/m higher accuracy  



QoL: Machine unlocks balancing 

QoL: Loading Speed - When loading previous saves items on conveyors will be cleared. This is due to changes in the saving system to improve memory and loading speed. 


More Performance improvements and Steam Cloud Save  


As we have mentioned before, we are aware of the performance issues. We are still working hard on this, our two programmers being full time on trying to improve this matter. The performance has improved with recent changes, and we have also detected that sound is playing a part on this. For some of you that want to build huge factories and get 3 stars, muting the game in Pause - Settings, will improve the performance as well. We know that this is not enough, so we are still doing are best to get the game to the best possible status.  

Regarding Steam Cloud Save, initially, we mistakenly had it for developers only. We have set it for players, and successfully tried saving. However, for some players is still being an issue, so please contact us via mail (support@overpoweredteam.com) or Discord or mail if that is your case so we can see what's happening.  



We are trying to respond to each and every single one of you!   



If you’d like to help us out or if you are having any other issue, please send us your save files zipped to: support@overpoweredteam.com To find the saves folder follow this route: C:\\Users\\YOUR_USERNAME_HERE\\AppData\\LocalLow\\OverPowered Team\\Block Factory  



Again, we really appreciate all the kind words, patience and support. We keep working hard every day.

notes.title: ROAD TO RELEASE
notes.content:
Hello Block fans,

Block Factory was initially introduced to you back in late August, when we launched our first Playtest. We gathered tons of valuable insights from the community which helped shape the game to something more suited to your expectations!

What we achieved together

We worked hard on refining the onboarding process, to help you learn the specifics of our game more smoothly. We also improved some aspects of the User Interface, to be more in-line with similar games of the genre and reduce friction.

The addition of the Challenge Mode also offered another flavour to the game, players now have to scratch their heads and optimize their production and workflow to reach new goals.

Things got more serious for Block Factory during the Steam Next Fest last October. We got a big influx of new players and even content creators took some time to try the game out. The community also contributed in its own way, by submitting their own creations to the Steam workshop. 
This phase really helped us to gather feedback and helped us to have a clearer perspective on the road ahead.

The Road Ahead

So what’s next for Block Factory? To be fully transparent with you, we initially envisioned an Early Access phase, to continue improving the game.
But thanks to all the feedback we have received, we feel more confident to work on what we already know, solidify the basics, create more levels to get ready for a full release in early 2025.


We cannot wait to show you the final version of Block Factory! See you very soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827680/Block_Factory/

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
First of all, we wanted to thank all of you who joined us to play the Demo during the Steam Next Fest.
We have seen a substantial influx of players and even more feedback on Discord and Feature Upvote.

We have dedicated our efforts to  bug fixing and to also overhaul one of our core systems: the Units Calculations System. It would not have been possible if not for your feedback. We have worked very hard on this and it has proven to be quite challenging from a development perspective!

So let's hear what you think about it, and let us know if some additional tweaking is required! 


Main Fix: u/m calculations rework 
 All units per minute (u/m) calculations are fixed and should be displayed correctly.
Fixes 
Bugs while loading
 Random rotations in output items
 Gluer and Stacker not recognizing input
 Right click mass delete freezing
 Bug Conveyor + Teleporter
Improvements 
 Conveyor anchors: Now you can press "C" while building a conveyor to place an anchor and make as many corners as you need.
 Star Goals Display: Any completed figure will show the stars required units per minute (u/m) when hovering.
 Re-assign figurine in compass at end of level.
 Paste over conveyors
 Undo recovers machine configuration

Thank you all for your involvement and feedback over these last two weeks, we'll be back soon, to have a look at your latest creations, we had quite some fun, but some of you really need to get better at this ngl).

If you want to to continue discussing all things Block Factory, come and see us on our Discord server!

notes.title: Block Factory Playtest Update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We have now released our first major update for the Block Factory playtest. This update is shaped by the feedback and suggestions you’ve shared on Feature Upvote (our public board). It brings a number of major changes to the game thanks to the insights we’ve gathered since the playtest began!

Invites have been sent to all who have applied to participate, don’t forget to request access if you haven’t already! 

Save files have been wiped and all progress has been reset. 

Check out the full changelist here:

New content
 New level: Dinner
 New figurines: 
 Tuna Sushi
 Omelette Sushi 
 Egg
 New machines: 
 Rounder. Use a Rounder to modify pieces and give them a smooth finish. 
 Bleacher. Paint any block white without dyes. 
 Burner. Paint any block black without dyes. 
 Double Cutter. This machine allows you to keep both sides of a cut figure, enabling recycling of materials. It must be unlocked through the Upgrades Menu.

User Interface & Usability Improvements
 The tutorial now has a button to better guide you through the steps.
 Added visual Hotkeys throughout the UI to help you navigate the game with more ease.
 If you click on the side panel "Complete Diorama" when you deliver all the figurines, it will now open the Diorama Window instead of centering the Diorama on screen.
 Added a Top View (Hotkey "T") feature to give a new perspective to the game, letting you see all machines properly without them hiding behind others.
 Dragging the camera with the mouse will now more accurately keep the floor under the mouse in place.
 Camera rotation now follows your mouse instead of setting a constant rotating speed.

Machine & Conveyor Mechanics
 Machine speed is now represented in Units Per Second (u/s) to calculate optimal machine placement more easily.
 Most machine speeds have been tweaked to align with Piece and Dye Dispensers output speeds (1 u/s).
 Conveyors now behave more smoothly.
 Conveyors auto-connect to machines and other conveyors when placed adjacent to them.
 Teleporters now have a brief delay when receiving a piece for the first time, matching the time it takes a conveyor to move that piece from TP-input to TP-output.
 Subsequent pieces are teleported at the same rate as a conveyor (4 u/s).
 When making a big selection, the Machine Actions menu now appears on screen, even if the selection area was previously off-screen.

Upgrades & Machines
 The Upgrade System of the Island Menu has been improved with the following changes:
 Added visual representation for each unlockable machine.
 Easier navigation and understanding of the upgrade section.
 Upgrade costs have been tweaked so you can upgrade more items.

Bug Fixes & Performance
 Fixed several reported minor bugs and softlock issues.


Thank you all for your feedback and suggestions, we can't wait to hear your thoughts and feedback on this update!

notes.title: The Block Factory Playtest is now live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we’re excited to announce that the Block Factory playtest is live! 

In last week’s blog post we shared what content is available in the playtest. Since then, we have decided to add the following features: 
 Challenge Mode: Once you have completed an Island/Level in the Campaign Mode, you will be able to play it in the Challenge Mode. In this mode, speed is key! You will have to deliver a certain amount of each figurine as fast as you can to get a star rank. If you want 3 stars, you will need to optimise your factory!
 Tech Tree / Upgrade System: After delivering the first unit of a figurine, your factory will continue to produce more units that will be stored. After delivering X units of a figurine, you will be rewarded with a coin. Coins are used in the Archipelago Menu to buy new machines, upgrade mechanics or improve your production speed.
Bug reports, Feedback and Suggestions
We’ve set up a public bug tracker and suggestions board, Feature Upvote, that allows you to submit any issues you might be experiencing, or suggestions you might like to see added or changed, and vote on them as a community. This gives us a clearer view of how prevalent each issue or idea is and prioritise accordingly.

We love to involve the community in our development, we value all suggestions and feedback as we work together to build a better game.

You can also join our Discord to discuss your ideas with us and other players! 


Content Creators 
You are free to live stream, record and share videos of the playtest. We would appreciate it if you mention that the build you are playing is a playtest / beta version of Block Factory. Please get in touch with us if you have any questions or requests via Twitter / X or on our Discord server.   


Haven’t signed up yet? 
For those of you who haven’t signed up yet, don’t worry you haven’t missed out. The playtest will run until September 2nd so don’t forget to request access by signing up on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2827680/Block_Factory/

If you have any questions don’t hesitate to share them in the comments and we’ll try our best to answer them all.

notes.title: Block Factory FAQ
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

We've received a few questions from you since we announced Block Factory last week, so we thought it would be a good idea to answer them here. 
Feel free to share any other questions you might have in the comments and we'll get back to you as soon as possible! 

What is Block Factory?
Block Factory is a production and automation game focusing on creating 3D figurines from building blocks in a factory. Shape your models, design and optimize your assembly lines to bring your creations to life! Developed by OverPowered Team and published by Shiro Unlimited. 

When is the Early Access release date?
Q4 2024

Will there be a demo?
Yes, in a couple of months and we’re also planning a playtest so stay tuned! 

Where can I stay up to date with the latest news? 
Steam, Discord, X/Twitter, Reddit and TikTok. 

What were your inspirations?
Of course, top-tier automation games like Shapez and Factorio are among our inspirations. However, we also aimed to appeal to a broader audience, so we drew inspiration from other management games like Dorfromantik and Mini Metro.

Will it have multiplayer or co-op features?
Not at EA launch.

What are the minimum and recommended system specs to run Block Factory?

[tr]
[th]Minimum:[/th]
[th]Recommended:[/th]

[/tr]

[/tr]

[td]Storage: 2 GB available space[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

What languages will be supported?
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain), Galician, Russian, Simplified Chinese

Will mods be supported?
No plans for mod support.

Will Steam Deck or controllers be supported?
No plans at this moment in time, but we are open to exploring this depending on the demand. 


Will there be achievements?
Yes. 

Can I join a playtest?
Yes but your access will not be guaranteed.

How can I support the development of Block Factory?
You can support us by wishlisting the game on Steam, signing up for the playtest and following us on social media.
